verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents bulk payments to vendors, employees, and contractors, and its Instant Pay API advertises batch payments, so bulk operations exist for payouts. The docs also mention creating virtual cards for an entire team. However, the evidence is marketing-level: no batch endpoint, limits, or bulk operations for other item types (e.g., bulk card limit edits) are documented, and nothing shows bulk actions via the MCP server for AI-native use. Missing for 10: documented batch API endpoint details and limits, bulk edit/update operations across cards or other items, bulk actions exposed through MCP/agent tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Pay vendors, employees, and contractors in bulk across 150+ countries & 40+ currencies without transfer fees or wire fees.
Batch payments, real-time webhooks, TypeScript and Python SDKs.
instantly create virtual cards for your entire team, all for free.
